_source: Ready-Mix Concrete (CAT-12), Oct 2026 — READY_MIX_CATALOGUE.md. Priced grades trace to a dated retail listing (Ozzon.co.za, delivered full loads, incl. VAT); list = benchmark x 1.08 (8% AA storefront margin, PRICING_POLICY.md). Grades with no benchmark have no price and route to a quote — never interpolate one (AGENTIC_RULES.md rule 1). Pumps are priced separately and stay quote-only until written supplier quotes are loaded.

products.name: Ready-Mix Concrete 10 MPa
products.source_note: No retail benchmark found for 10 MPa specifically — blinding/mass-fill grade, typically quoted directly. Confirm with supplier before publishing.
products.handling_notes: Begins setting within roughly 90 minutes of batching — pour and finish promptly. Minimum order is a full mixer-truck load, not a partial quantity.
